title: Aegis Policy Document v0
description: Canonical policy contract read by every Aegis PEP form factor (trust SDK in-process, MCP proxy, core gateway). One policy document drives all enforcement strengths; customers upgrade enforcement without rewriting policy.

policy_schema_version.description: Canonical policy schema version. Readers MUST fail-closed (deny all) when they encounter a version greater than they support.

policy_id.description: Stable identifier for this policy document (used in audit events' evidence.policy).

purposes.description: Map of purpose name to its disclosure rule. Combines field-level disclosure rules (scope/deny_fields) with sensitivity-level gating (max_level, legal_basis, retention_days) and per-purpose field allowlists.

tools.description: Map of tool/function name to purpose name. Optional: callers may also declare purpose explicitly per call; explicit declaration takes precedence.

roles.description: Optional role layer . A role constrains which purposes a principal may invoke. Enforced natively by the gateway; SDK and MCP proxy treat it as advisory unless they can resolve the principal's role.

defaults.description: Fail-closed defaults. v0 admits no permissive default: unknown purpose, unknown destination, and unparseable policy all deny.

unknown_tool.description: What to do when a tool is not in `tools` and the call declares no purpose. block = deny; passthrough_unfiltered is intentionally NOT offered in v0.

fieldPath.description: Dot-notation field path (trust SDK semantics): no leading/trailing dots, no consecutive dots. Array indices allowed (users.0.email).

scope.description: Whitelist of field paths released for this purpose. scope: [] is valid and releases nothing (fail-closed). Mutually exclusive with deny_fields.

deny_fields.description: Blacklist of field paths removed for this purpose. An empty list is INVALID (trust SDK invariant: hiding nothing is a misconfiguration). Mutually exclusive with scope.

max_level.description: Maximum sensitivity level this purpose may touch (sensitivity gating). Optional in v0; gateway enforces, SDK/proxy enforce when a field classification is available.

legal_basis.description: GDPR Art.6 legal basis (optional GDPR metadata).

retention_days.description: GDPR Art.30(1)(g) retention period in days (optional GDPR metadata).

destinations.description: Egress boundary for this purpose (v0 requirement: the destination dimension is part of v0, not a later addition). Controls where data filtered under this purpose may be sent. Destination labels are namespaced strings, e.g. llm:openai, llm:anthropic, webhook:slack, internal:db.

allow.description: Whitelist of destination labels. Mutually exclusive with deny. allow: [] means no egress permitted.

deny.description: Blacklist of destination labels. Mutually exclusive with allow. An empty list is invalid.

allow_purposes.description: Whitelist of purpose names this role may invoke. Mutually exclusive with deny_purposes.

deny_purposes.description: Blacklist of purpose names. Mutually exclusive with allow_purposes. Empty list invalid.
